answer: Each agent ID has to keep a beacon running: a signed heartbeat answering a random relay ping within 300 ms from a distinct /24 address. A farm with 400 fakes needs 400 separate IP ranges, since two IDs answering from one subnet get merged into one voting slot. Residential ranges cost about $3 a month each, and you can't bulk-buy them from a single provider without the ASN tag giving the farm away. A bridge between two garden subnets doesn't help, because the ping timing exposes the extra hop. The bill grows with every fake added.
